1.e4 e5 2.Bb5 Nf6 3.d4.strategy: Opens the centre at once, offering a pawn for activity instead of developing. Black's knight already attacks e4, and the b5-bishop has no knight to pin, so White's activity is limited: a risky try rather than a good one.
1.e4 e5 2.Bb5 Nf6 3.d4.name: Portuguese Opening: Portuguese Gambit
